description: This file contains functions related to thinking levels, provider capabilities, and default reasoning configurations, specifically for handling different thinking modes and integrating with external plugins and shared logic.

methods.name: isBinaryThinkingProvider
methods.description: Determines if a given provider supports binary thinking mode based on plugin decision.

methods.name: supportsXHighThinking
methods.description: Checks if a provider supports the 'xhigh' thinking level based on plugin decision.

methods.name: listThinkingLevels
methods.description: Returns a list of thinking levels, including 'xhigh' if supported.

methods.name: listThinkingLevelLabels
methods.description: Provides labels for thinking levels, returning ['off', 'on'] for binary providers.

methods.name: formatThinkingLevels
methods.description: Formats the list of thinking levels into a string, considering support for 'xhigh'.

methods.name: resolveThinkingDefaultForModel
methods.description: Resolves the default thinking level for a given model and provider, using plugin decisions or fallback.
